prompt: I have a Flask app that already has Tailwind v4 + basecoat-css 1.0 installed via npm and imports "basecoat-css/all" in its JS bundle. Write templates/members.html.jinja (extends "base.html.jinja", block name `content`) that lists `members` (each has id, name, email, role, status in 'active'|'invited'|'suspended', avatar_url which may be None). I need: page header with an 'Invite member' button, a table with avatar+name, email, a role column, a colored status badge, and a per-row actions menu (Edit, Resend invite, Remove - remove should look dangerous). Show a nice empty state when there are no members, and prev/next pagination at the bottom using `page` and `total_pages`.
assertions: Extends base.html.jinja and fills the content block
Row menu uses .dropdown-menu with data-popover, role="menu" and role="menuitem"
Menu trigger is wired with aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-controls
Per-row ids are unique (derived from member.id or loop index)
Dropdown is not placed inside a scrolling .table-container
Avatar uses .avatar with a fallback when avatar_url is None
Status uses .badge with a variant or color per status
Remove action is styled as destructive
Pagination uses .btn links with page / total_pages
